news.titleEn: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO. Stock skyrockets 31%
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia's board unanimously voted to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO, president and director, and the stock jumped about 31% in a single session.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达董事会一致决定让黄仁勋复任CEO，股价单日暴涨约31%。
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the bellwether of the AI trade; its leadership crisis had helped drag global tech stocks into a correction, so his return reset sentiment across markets.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI行情风向标，其领导层危机曾拖累全球科技股，黄仁勋回归扭转市场情绪。
news.detailEn: Huang resigned earlier this month after admitting to personal misconduct, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO, and the stock lost roughly a third of its value. The board said it reinstated him after a series of discussions, and the one-day gain added close to $1 trillion in market value, Nvidia's best day in more than two decades. Critics in Congress say questions over export controls remain unanswered, and the board's independent investigation is still a governance overhang.
news.detailZh: 黄仁勋本月早些时候承认个人行为不当后辞职，CFO科莱特·克雷斯暂代CEO，股价期间累计蒸发约三分之一。董事会表示经过多轮沟通后决定让其复职，单日市值增加近1万亿美元，创二十多年来最佳单日表现。国会部分议员仍要求就出口管制问题作出解释，董事会的独立调查也仍是公司治理上的隐患。

news.titleEn: Dow soars 1,400 points; Nasdaq surges 6% in its best day since April 2025 as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia
news.conclusionEn: US stocks staged a huge rebound on Monday, with the S&P 500 up about 4.7% and the Nasdaq up about 6.5%, recovering roughly half of last week's plunge.
news.conclusionZh: 美股周一大反弹，标普涨约4.7%、纳指涨约6.5%，收复上周近半跌幅。
news.whyEn: The rally snapped the S&P 500's seven-day losing streak after a correction, easing fears of a deeper AI-led bear market for global investors.
news.whyZh: 此轮反弹终结标普七连跌，缓解了市场对AI引发深度熊市的担忧。
news.detailEn: Last week the Nasdaq fell about 10%, its worst week in more than six years, as Nvidia's leadership turmoil and AI-spending worries hit tech. The VIX volatility index dropped sharply and Brent crude fell below $90 a barrel on Monday. Strategists are split on whether the correction is over, and markets still face a likely Federal Reserve rate hike in December and inflation data during the Thanksgiving-shortened week.
news.detailZh: 上周纳指下跌约10%，为六年多来最差单周表现，英伟达领导层动荡和AI支出担忧重创科技股。周一波动率指数VIX大幅回落，布伦特原油跌破每桶90美元。策略师对调整是否结束看法分歧，市场仍需面对美联储12月大概率加息以及感恩节缩短交易周内公布的通胀数据。

news.titleEn: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler in $44 billion deal as AI supercharges cyberattacks
news.conclusionEn: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal worth about $43.9 billion, a 34% premium, creating a security giant with over $10 billion in combined ARR.
news.conclusionZh: CrowdStrike以约439亿美元全股票收购Zscaler，溢价34%。
news.whyEn: It is one of the largest cybersecurity deals ever and signals consolidation as AI-driven attacks push customers toward single-platform vendors.
news.whyZh: 这是网络安全史上最大并购之一，显示AI时代行业正加速整合为平台化巨头。
news.detailEn: Zscaler holders will receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares per share, valuing Zscaler at about $260 a share. CrowdStrike shares fell around 9-10% on dilution concerns despite beating quarterly estimates, while Zscaler jumped about 13-15%. The company targets $500 million in annual cost savings and about $1 billion in revenue synergies; the deal still needs Zscaler shareholder and regulatory approval and is expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028.
news.detailZh: Zscaler股东每股可换得1.135股CrowdStrike股票，对应每股约260美元。尽管季度业绩超预期，CrowdStrike股价因摊薄担忧下跌约9-10%，Zscaler则上涨约13-15%。公司目标实现每年5亿美元成本节省和约10亿美元收入协同；交易仍需Zscaler股东及监管批准，预计在CrowdStrike 2028财年下半年完成。

news.titleEn: Nvidia partner and supplier stocks in Asia jump after Jensen Huang's return
news.conclusionEn: Asian chip stocks surged on Tuesday, with SK Hynix and Samsung leading the Kospi up around 6% and Advantest and Tokyo Electron jumping about 12% in Tokyo.
news.conclusionZh: 亚洲芯片股周二大涨，韩国KOSPI涨约6%，东京芯片股涨约12%。
news.whyEn: Asian suppliers were among the hardest hit in the AI selloff, so the rebound matters for Korean, Japanese and Taiwanese markets and retail investors.
news.whyZh: 亚洲供应链股此前跌得最惨，反弹直接影响日韩台股市和散户。
news.detailEn: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix together make up more than 40% of the Kospi, so their gains drove the index sharply higher. Tokyo was closed on Monday, making Tuesday its first chance to price in Huang's return. Regional regulators had rolled out stabilisation steps such as short-selling curbs and buyback relaxations last week, and investors will watch whether the rebound holds.
news.detailZh: 三星电子和SK海力士合计占KOSPI权重超过40%，二者大涨带动指数飙升。东京股市周一休市，周二是首次反映黄仁勋回归的交易日。上周亚洲各地监管机构已推出限制做空、放宽回购等稳市措施，投资者将关注此次反弹能否持续。

news.titleEn: Bahrain accuses Iran of striking industrial site as tankers hit in Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: Bahrain said Iran struck a civilian industrial site near its refinery hub, while tankers were hit in or near the Strait of Hormuz over the weekend.
news.conclusionZh: 巴林指伊朗袭击其工业设施，霍尔木兹海峡周末再有油轮遇袭。
news.whyEn: Attacks on Gulf energy sites and Hormuz shipping threaten a key oil chokepoint and keep a risk premium in energy markets.
news.whyZh: 海湾能源设施和霍尔木兹航运遇袭威胁全球石油要道，影响油价。
news.detailEn: Smoke was seen over Sitra Island, home to a Bapco refinery, and Bahrain said two people were injured; Iranian media claimed attacks on US bases in Bahrain. Iran's navy said two tankers hit sea mines near the strait, while Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar and the Arab League condemned the strikes. Oil prices nonetheless fell on Monday as Hormuz flows approached pre-war levels and surplus forecasts dominated, but further escalation could quickly reverse that.
news.detailZh: 巴林国营炼油厂所在的锡特拉岛上空可见浓烟，巴林称两人受伤；伊朗媒体称袭击了美国驻巴林基地。伊朗海军称两艘油轮在海峡附近触雷，沙特、科威特、卡塔尔及阿拉伯联盟均予以谴责。不过由于霍尔木兹航运量接近战前水平、市场预期供应过剩，周一油价仍下跌，但局势若进一步升级可能迅速逆转。

news.titleEn: Global climate summit collapses as countries fail to agree on moving away from fossil fuels
news.conclusionEn: The COP31 UN climate summit in Antalya ended without an overarching agreement after record-long overtime talks deadlocked over fossil fuels and finance.
news.conclusionZh: 安塔利亚COP31气候大会因化石燃料分歧未能达成整体协议。
news.whyEn: The failure weakens global decarbonisation signals for energy investors and leaves poorer nations without new adaptation finance commitments.
news.whyZh: 失败削弱全球减碳政策信号，影响能源投资方向，穷国也拿不到新资金承诺。
news.detailEn: Saudi Arabia and other OPEC members opposed any mention of a fossil-fuel transition, while the EU, Norway and several island states rejected a text that omitted it. Some technical items, such as the adaptation goal and carbon-market rules, were still adopted, so analysts debate whether it was a total collapse. Unresolved issues, including a proposed $120 billion adaptation finance target, move to the Bonn session next June.
news.detailZh: 沙特等欧佩克成员反对文本提及摆脱化石燃料，欧盟、挪威和多个岛国则拒绝不含该内容的草案。适应目标、碳市场规则等部分技术议题仍获通过，因此分析人士对是否属于彻底失败存在争议。包括1200亿美元适应资金目标在内的未决问题将推至明年6月波恩会议继续谈判。

news.titleEn: Ukrainian drones sink Russian warship in North Africa
news.conclusionEn: Ukraine said its drones sank a Russian corvette at a Libyan port and hit a Russian cargo ship, as a separate drone strike set a Russian freighter ablaze in the Baltic.
news.conclusionZh: 乌克兰称在利比亚击沉俄军舰，波罗的海另有俄货轮遭无人机袭击。
news.whyEn: Ukraine's long-range strikes are widening the war's maritime front, raising risks for shipping and insurance in the Mediterranean and Baltic.
news.whyZh: 乌克兰远程打击扩大海上战线，地中海和波罗的海航运及保险风险上升。
news.detailEn: Zelensky said the cargo ship off Libya was being used by Russia to move weapons. In the Baltic, the Russian freighter Sparta II caught fire and drifted into Finnish waters, and the Kremlin accused Kyiv of 'terrorist activity' and warned of painful consequences. The incidents could complicate ongoing peace diplomacy and prompt Russia to escort or reroute vessels.
news.detailZh: 泽连斯基称利比亚附近被击中的货轮被俄方用于运输武器。在波罗的海，俄罗斯货轮Sparta II起火并漂入芬兰海域，克里姆林宫指责基辅从事「恐怖活动」并警告将付出代价。这些事件可能给正在进行的和平外交增添变数，并促使俄方为船只护航或改变航线。

businessTips.explanationEn: Key person risk is the danger that a company's value or operations depend heavily on one individual, such as a founder or star executive. If that person leaves, falls ill or faces scandal, strategy, relationships and investor confidence can all suffer at once. Boards manage it with succession plans, deputies who can step up, documented processes and sometimes key-person insurance.
businessTips.explanationZh: 关键人物风险指公司价值或运营高度依赖某一个人（如创始人或明星高管）。一旦此人离职、生病或陷入丑闻，战略、客户关系和投资者信心可能同时受挫。董事会通常通过继任计划、培养可顶上的副手、流程文档化以及关键人物保险来管理这一风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: Nvidia lost about a third of its market value after Jensen Huang resigned, then regained much of it in one day when he was reinstated. Even a small business faces the same issue if only the owner knows the suppliers and pricing.
businessTips.exampleZh: 黄仁勋辞职后英伟达市值蒸发约三分之一，他复职当天又收复大半。即使是小生意，如果只有老板一个人掌握供应商和定价信息，也面临同样的风险。

businessTips.explanationEn: A minimum viable audience is the smallest group of people who care enough about your work to keep a side project or small business alive. Instead of chasing mass reach, you focus on a narrow niche whose problems you understand deeply. A few hundred engaged followers who trust you can support paid products, while thousands of passive followers often cannot.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行受众是指足以支撑一个副业或小生意持续运转的最小人群。与其追求大范围曝光，不如聚焦一个你深刻理解其痛点的细分群体。几百个信任你、愿意互动的粉丝就能支撑付费产品，而几千个被动关注者往往做不到。
businessTips.exampleEn: A food blogger in Australia might target Chinese-speaking international students in one city rather than all foodies. With 500 loyal readers, a paid dining guide or restaurant partnership can already cover costs.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位澳洲美食博主可以专注某个城市的华人留学生，而不是所有吃货。有了500名忠实读者，一份付费探店指南或餐厅合作就足以覆盖成本。

businessTips.term: Exchange Ratio & Dilution in All-Stock Deals
businessTips.explanationEn: In an all-stock acquisition, the buyer pays with its own newly issued shares at a fixed exchange ratio instead of cash. Target shareholders gain upside if the buyer's stock rises, but existing buyer shareholders are diluted because the share count grows. Markets often push the acquirer's price down on announcement if they doubt synergies will outweigh that dilution.
businessTips.explanationZh: 在全股票收购中，收购方用新发行的自家股票按固定换股比例支付，而不是现金。被收购方股东可分享收购方股价未来上涨，但收购方原股东会因总股本增加而被摊薄。如果市场怀疑协同效应不足以弥补摊薄，收购方股价往往在公告后下跌。
businessTips.exampleEn: CrowdStrike offered 1.135 of its shares for each Zscaler share, adding roughly 19% to its share count, and its stock fell about 10% on the news. Investors holding either stock should check the ratio and whether the target's value moves with the acquirer's price.
businessTips.exampleZh: CrowdStrike按每股Zscaler换1.135股的比例收购，总股本增加约19%，消息公布后股价下跌约10%。持有任一方股票的投资者应关注换股比例，以及被收购方价值会随收购方股价波动这一点。
